create_exp_relaxed_categorical: create an ExpRelaxedCategorical distribution with temperature, logits, and sample_shape for gumbel-softmax reparameterized sampling
create_relaxed_one_hot_categorical: create a RelaxedOneHotCategorical distribution with temperature and logits that returns simplex-constrained reparameterized samples
rsample_exp_relaxed_categorical: rsample from an ExpRelaxedCategorical distribution using gumbel-softmax to generate continuous relaxed categorical samples
log_prob_exp_relaxed_categorical: compute the log probability of a value under an ExpRelaxedCategorical distribution
expand_relaxed_one_hot_categorical: expand a RelaxedOneHotCategorical distribution to a new batch shape while preserving temperature and logits
